answer: A sustainable agent economy prices identity through audited contribution, not registration. Every key must answer prompts that independent graders score, and only accumulated, verified history earns weight; a sybil can shout into a gale of its own copies and still gain nothing, because copies carry no evidence. Honest participants climb toward a summit one attested step at a time. The design reads like a sonnet: fixed cost per line, and only coherent lines are accepted, so mass-produced filler fails the form while genuine work is cheap to submit and expensive to fake.
